description: This is a unit test class for JsonArrayValueValidator in the Eclipse Ditto project. It tests validation behavior for JSON array strings, including null handling, proper acceptance of valid inputs, and rejection of invalid ones.

classes.name: JsonArrayValueValidatorTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the behavior of JsonArrayValueValidator, ensuring it correctly validates JSON array string inputs.

methods.name: setUpClass
methods.description: Initializes a valid JSON array string before all tests.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that the JsonArrayValueValidator class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that the validator throws NullPointerException when given a null definition.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Verifies that a DittoHeaderInvalidException is thrown when the value to validate is null.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Ensures that a valid JSON array string is accepted without exception.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotJsonArray
methods.description: Checks that the validator does not reject valid JSON for types not defined as JSON arrays.

methods.name: acceptNonJsonArrayString
methods.description: Tests rejection of a string that is not a valid JSON array.

methods.name: acceptJsonArrayStringWithNonStringItems
methods.description: Ensures that JSON arrays containing non-string items are rejected with the appropriate exception.
